assessment.why: Many concrete motives now established. Dada's threat has theatrical explanation and Barb's concealment is troubling, but nothing identifies who stole poison or treated the toast glass.

plausibility_notes: Thirty characters all confess compromising behavior in polished monologues; useful distribution of motive, but less conversationally natural.
